Rain tapped softly against the windowpane.
雨輕輕敲打著窗玻璃。
A ball broke the windowpane and scattered glass on the floor.
一顆球打破了窗玻璃，碎片散落一地。
A line of ducklings followed their mother across the road.
一排小鴨跟著鴨媽媽過馬路。
The duckling swam happily in the little pond.
小鴨在小池塘裡開心地游著。
The car had one broken headlamp, so the police stopped it.
那輛車有一盞車頭燈壞了，所以被警察攔了下來。
She wore a headlamp to read in the dark tent.
她戴著頭燈在漆黑的帳篷裡看書。
The speech was long and uninspiring.
那場演講又長又乏味，毫無啟發。
We ate an uninspiring meal at the airport.
我們在機場吃了一頓平淡無奇的餐。
He found the job uninspiring and soon quit.
他覺得這份工作毫無吸引力，很快就辭職了。
The runners passed unhindered through the open gate.
跑者們毫無阻礙地穿過敞開的大門。
Scientists want unhindered access to the data.
科學家希望能不受限制地取得這些資料。

cooled.zh: 使冷卻；變涼（cool 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: We let the soup cool, and by then it had cooled enough to eat.
我們讓湯放涼，到那時它已涼到可以喝了。
The evening breeze cooled the hot streets.
傍晚的微風使炙熱的街道涼了下來。
After the argument, they cooled down and talked calmly.
爭吵之後，他們冷靜下來，平心靜氣地談話。
Pour the cooled tea over the ice.
把放涼的茶倒在冰塊上。
The cooled engine can be touched safely.
冷卻後的引擎可以安全觸摸。
Her enthusiasm for the project remained undiminished.
她對這個專案的熱情絲毫未減。
The band's popularity is undiminished after twenty years.
這個樂團的人氣在二十年後依然不減。
She tied a bib around the baby before the meal.
用餐前，她在寶寶脖子上繫了一條圍兜。
The baby's bib was covered with orange carrot puree.
寶寶的圍兜沾滿了橘色的胡蘿蔔泥。

unacceptably.zh: 無法接受地；令人無法容忍地
ai: The noise from the road was unacceptably loud.
路上的噪音大到令人無法接受。
The service was unacceptably slow, so we left.
服務慢到令人無法忍受，所以我們離開了。
The committee is a deliberative body that studies each proposal carefully.
這個委員會是個審議機構，會仔細研究每一項提案。
He has a calm, deliberative way of making decisions.
他做決定的方式冷靜又慎重。
It was a cold, blustery day, and my umbrella blew inside out.
那天又冷又風大，我的傘被吹得翻了過來。
We stayed indoors because of the blustery weather.
因為天氣風大，我們待在室內。
The famous chef arrived with a few young acolytes.
那位名廚帶著幾名年輕的追隨者來了。
The priest and his acolyte lit the candles before the service.
神父和他的助手在儀式前點燃了蠟燭。
The family suffered great privation during the long winter.
這家人在漫長的冬天裡吃盡了苦頭。
Many people lived in privation after the flood destroyed their homes.
洪水毀掉家園後，許多人過著缺衣少食的生活。
The book explains how militarism led the country into war.
這本書說明了軍國主義如何把國家帶入戰爭。
Many people protested against rising militarism.
許多人抗議日益抬頭的軍國主義。
The baby's favorite plaything is a soft rubber duck.
寶寶最喜歡的玩具是一隻軟軟的橡皮鴨。
The kitten turned my shoelace into a plaything.
小貓把我的鞋帶當成了玩具。
He felt like a plaything in the hands of the rich.
他覺得自己像是有錢人手中的玩物。
The small boat was a plaything of the waves.
那艘小船任憑海浪擺布。
The puppy cried pitifully outside the door.
小狗在門外可憐兮兮地哭叫。
He looked at us pitifully and asked for a bit of food.
他可憐兮兮地看著我們，想討一點食物。
After careful perusal of the contract, she signed it.
仔細閱讀合約後，她簽了名。
The documents are available for your perusal at the front desk.
文件放在櫃檯，供您細閱。
He plays the tuba in the school band.
他在學校樂隊裡吹大號。
The deep sound of the tuba filled the hall.
大號低沉的聲音充滿了整個大廳。
We had chili with a slice of warm cornbread.
我們吃了辣豆醬，配一片溫熱的玉米麵包。
Grandma bakes cornbread in a heavy iron pan.
奶奶用一個厚重的鐵鍋烤玉米麵包。
He used a bungee to hold the bag on the back of his bike.
他用一條彈力繩把袋子固定在腳踏車後座。
A bungee cord keeps the tent flap from blowing open.
彈力繩讓帳篷的門簾不會被風吹開。
She was too scared to try bungee jumping from the bridge.
她太害怕，不敢從橋上嘗試高空彈跳。
My brother wants to go bungee jumping on his birthday.
我哥哥想在生日那天去玩高空彈跳。
The doctor used a splint to immobilise his broken arm.
醫生用夾板固定他骨折的手臂。
Heavy snow threatened to immobilise the whole city.
大雪可能使整座城市動彈不得。
The building has tall fluted columns at the entrance.
這棟建築的入口有高大的凹槽圓柱。
She baked a cake in a fluted pan.
她用有波紋凹槽的模具烤了一個蛋糕。
The coach praised the physicality of the team's play.
教練稱讚球隊踢球時的身體對抗強度。
The dancer's performance showed great physicality and grace.
這位舞者的表演展現了強大的身體表現力與優雅。
The woodcutter tried to cleave the log with one blow.
樵夫試著一斧把原木劈開。
The ship's bow seemed to cleave the waves.
船頭彷彿把海浪劈開。
The couple promised to cleave to each other through good times and bad.
這對伴侶承諾不論順境逆境都彼此相守。
The wet cloth began to cleave to his skin.
濕布開始黏貼在他的皮膚上。

delaying.zh: 延遲；拖延（delay 的現在分詞）
ai: Heavy rain is delaying all the flights this morning.
今天早上的大雨使所有航班延誤。
Stop delaying and start your homework.
別再拖了，開始寫功課吧。
They are delaying the trip until the weather improves.
他們把旅行延後，等天氣好轉再說。
The robin is a prototypical example of a small songbird.
知更鳥是小型鳴禽的典型例子。
This old machine is the prototypical design for later models.
這台舊機器是後來各款機型的原型設計。
He unwisely spent all his savings on one risky plan.
他不明智地把所有積蓄都花在一個冒險的計畫上。
They unwisely ignored the weather warning and went hiking.
他們不明智地無視天氣警報去健行。
The final match will test the mettle of both players.
決賽將考驗兩位選手的氣魄。
She showed her mettle by finishing the race with an injured foot.
她拖著受傷的腳跑完全程，展現了她的膽識。
The café was full of hipsters with beards and big glasses.
那間咖啡店裡滿是留著鬍子、戴著大眼鏡的文青。
My cousin is a hipster who only listens to old vinyl records.
我表哥是個只聽老黑膠唱片的文青。
The school accepts a certificate of equivalency instead of a diploma.
學校接受同等學力證明來取代畢業證書。
The chart shows the equivalency between miles and kilometers.
這張圖表顯示英里與公里之間的換算對等關係。

mediating.zh: 調解；斡旋（mediate 的現在分詞）
ai: The teacher is mediating between the two quarreling students.
老師正在兩個吵架的學生之間居中調解。
She spent the afternoon mediating a dispute between neighbors.
她整個下午都在調解鄰居之間的糾紛。
The United Nations is mediating talks between the two sides.
聯合國正在斡旋雙方的談判。
The town held a big parade to celebrate its bicentennial.
小鎮舉辦盛大遊行來慶祝建鎮兩百週年。
The museum printed a special book for the bicentennial.
博物館為兩百週年紀念印製了一本特別的書。
He was a sympathiser of the workers' cause.
他是工人運動的支持者。
Many sympathisers sent letters to support the family.
許多同情者寄信來聲援這個家庭。
She uses biofeedback to learn how to lower her stress.
她用生物回饋法學習降低壓力。
The clinic offers biofeedback training for people with headaches.
診所為頭痛患者提供生物回饋訓練。
We used a stencil to paint the letters on the sign.
我們用模板把字母漆在招牌上。
The teacher cut a star-shaped stencil out of cardboard.
老師用紙板剪出一個星形的模板。
He stencilled his name on the wooden box.
他用模板把名字印在木箱上。
The children stencilled flowers on the classroom wall.
孩子們用模板在教室牆上印出花朵。
The nurse performed triage to decide who needed help first.
護理師進行檢傷分類，決定誰該先接受治療。
Patients wait at the triage desk before seeing a doctor.
病患在看醫生之前，要先在檢傷分類櫃檯等候。
The doctor found an arrhythmia in his heartbeat.
醫生發現他的心跳有心律不整的現象。
Too much caffeine can cause arrhythmia in some people.
咖啡因攝取過量可能使某些人心律不整。
The law proscribes the sale of fireworks to children.
法律禁止向兒童販售煙火。
The school rules proscribe the use of phones in class.
校規明令禁止在課堂上使用手機。
Her son has dyslexia, so reading is hard for him.
她的兒子有閱讀障礙，所以閱讀對他很吃力。
Teachers use special methods to help students with dyslexia.
老師用特殊的方法幫助有閱讀障礙的學生。
Procrastination is my biggest problem when I study.
拖延是我念書時最大的問題。
His procrastination meant he finished the report at midnight.
他的拖延害他到半夜才寫完報告。
The kidneys help the body excrete waste.
腎臟幫助身體排出廢物。
Plants can excrete extra salt through their leaves.
植物可以透過葉子排出多餘的鹽分。

merged.zh: 合併；融合（merge 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The two small banks merged to form a larger one.
那兩家小銀行合併成一家較大的銀行。
The road merged with the highway near the bridge.
那條路在橋附近匯入了高速公路。
She merged the two files into a single document.
她把兩個檔案合併成一份文件。
